description: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
vibe: Security-first Go craftsmanship with strict module discipline and human-only community interactions.
highlights: Module system is the architectural backbone: everything registers via caddy.RegisterModule() with namespaced IDs and lifecycle hooks.
Compile-time interface guards (var _ caddy.Provisioner = (*MyModule)(nil)) enforce contract compliance.
AI contributions must be disclosed, fully comprehended by a human, tested, and license-verified.
Bots are explicitly forbidden from creating PRs, issues, or security reports; they must self-identify in reviews.
caddyhttp and caddytls require extra scrutiny in code review as security-critical packages.
assessment: This file demonstrates mature engineering taste by codifying Go idioms, module lifecycle patterns, and security-critical review zones into enforceable rules. The explicit AI contribution policy and human-only community interaction rules are unusually principled, protecting open-source integrity without sacrificing automation benefits. The emphasis on generalized solutions over case-specific patches reflects a long-term architectural mindset.
